hook_b: Hyderabad's extra *40 MGD* of Godavari water has a Nov 15 deadline
tldr: Ghanpur pipeline works must be done by Nov 15 to bring 40 MGD more Godavari water to the city.

beats.what: Ashok Reddy set a Nov 15 deadline for the Ghanpur pipeline works so Hyderabad can receive an additional 40 MGD of Godavari water.
beats.why: The city is also dealing with a Telangana rain deficit and falling groundwater.
beats.care: If your area has low pressure, this supply is meant to help, but only after the works are complete.
